name: Shapefiles of BOA and Community Brownfield Planning Areas - OER Existing Conditions Studies
description: This dataset contains polygon boundaries for nine Brownfield Opportunity Area (BOA) and community brownfield planning areas in New York City, drawn from the Office of Environmental Remediation's Existing Conditions Studies. Each record identifies a planning area by name (for example, Edgemere Arverne, Harlem Gateway, Red Hook, Zerega, and Farmers Boulevard), lists the community organization associated with it, and provides the polygon's area in square units along with a unique record ID. Two link fields point to the area's EPIC community page and to a downloadable Existing Conditions Study document; a contacts field is present but empty for all rows. The data can be used to map and compare the size and location of brownfield planning areas, connect each area to its sponsoring community group and supporting studies, and support environmental planning, land-use analysis, or outreach around brownfield redevelopment.
